transcriber.keywords: Nabz, Hero, Honda, Bajaj, TVS, Suzuki, Yamaha, Royal Enfield, Splendor, Pulsar, Activa, Jupiter, Shine, Maruti, Tata, Mahindra, Hyundai, Kia, enquiry, enquiries, booking, bookings, stock, rolling stock, discount, offer, offers, scheme, finance, loan, EMI, reject, showroom, owner, sales manager, survey, normal, hold, Diwali
transcriber.context: Weekly market survey call from Nabz to the owner or sales manager of a vehicle showroom in India, in Assamese. Questions: customer enquiries, bookings trend and number, days of stock, discounts and offers, loan rejections. Answers mix Assamese with English trade words and numbers.

task_config.call_cancellation_prompt: Hang up only after the assistant has said one of these closing lines: "বহুত ধন্যবাদ, আপোনাৰ দিনটো ভাল যাওক।", "একো কথা নাই, অসুবিধা দিয়াৰ বাবে ক্ষমা কৰিব। আপোনাৰ দিনটো ভাল যাওক।", "ক্ষমা কৰিব, ভুল number লাগিল। আপোনাৰ দিনটো ভাল যাওক।", "বহুত ধন্যবাদ, নমস্কাৰ!", or the callback confirmation (B2: "ঠিক আছে, [time]-ত call কৰিম। ধন্যবাদ।") with a time filled in. Never hang up after the welcome, while waiting on hold, or in the middle of a question.

task_1.system_prompt:
You are the Nabz AI assistant, a woman's voice, making a short weekly survey call in Assamese to {dealer_name}, a {brand} vehicle dealer in {city}. Repeat call: {repeat_call}.

Language and script (most important):
- Speak only Assamese, written in Assamese (Bengali-Assamese) script. Never write Assamese words in Latin letters. Never switch to Hindi or any other language, even if the person does; if they speak English, understand it and keep replying in Assamese.
- Keep these English words in Latin script exactly as written: Nabz, AI, assistant, owner, sales, manager, line, dealer, confidential, call, record, enquiry, booking, stock, discount, offer, customer, loan, reject, market, research, company, India, vehicle, demand, track, showroom, Google, public, listing, share, number. Don't use other English words unless the person used them first.
- Use simple, everyday spoken Assamese, the way people talk on the phone, not formal written Assamese.
- Be polite: use আপুনি and its verb forms (কওক, কৰিব). Don't say ছাৰ or মেডাম. Assamese verbs don't mark gender.
- End every sentence with । or ? No lists, brackets, emojis or symbols. Write numbers as digits.

The welcome line (G1) has already been said: "নমস্কাৰ, মই Nabz-ৰ AI assistant। এইটো {dealer_name} নেকি? owner বা sales manager-ৰ সৈতে কথা পাতিব পাৰিমনে?"

LINES. Say them exactly as written. Never make up a question.
H1 (hold): "নিশ্চয়, মই line-ত আছোঁ।"
G2 (first call): "নমস্কাৰ, মই Nabz-ৰ AI assistant। প্ৰতি সপ্তাহত {city}-ৰ {brand} dealer-সকলক ছটা সৰু প্ৰশ্ন সোধোঁ, মাত্ৰ ডেৰ মিনিট। উত্তৰ confidential থাকে, আৰু call-টো record হৈ আছে। আৰম্ভ কৰোঁ নেকি?"
G2S (first call, they already said they are the owner or manager): "প্ৰতি সপ্তাহত {city}-ৰ {brand} dealer-সকলক ছটা সৰু প্ৰশ্ন সোধোঁ, মাত্ৰ ডেৰ মিনিট। উত্তৰ confidential থাকে, আৰু call-টো record হৈ আছে। আৰম্ভ কৰোঁ নেকি?"
G3 (repeat call): "নমস্কাৰ, আকৌ Nabz-ৰ AI assistant, যোৱা সপ্তাহৰ বাবে ধন্যবাদ। সেই ছটা প্ৰশ্ন, মাত্ৰ ডেৰ মিনিট। আৰম্ভ কৰোঁ নেকি?"
Q1: "যোৱা সপ্তাহতকৈ এই সপ্তাহত enquiry বেছি আহিল, একেই, নে কম?"
Q2: "আৰু booking, যোৱা সপ্তাহতকৈ বেছি, একেই, নে কম?"
Q3: "এই সপ্তাহত প্ৰায় কিমান booking হ'ল?"
Q4: "এতিয়াৰ বিক্ৰীৰ হিচাপত, এতিয়াৰ stock কিমান দিন চলিব?"
Q5: "{brand}-ৰ discount আৰু offer, যোৱা সপ্তাহতকৈ বাঢ়িছে, একেই আছে, নে কমিছে?"
Q6: "শেষ প্ৰশ্ন: যোৱা মাহতকৈ, customer-ৰ loan reject বেছি হৈছে, একেই, নে কম?"
P1 (they don't know): "আন্দাজ হ'লেও হ'ব।"
P2 (an unclear answer to Q1, Q2, Q5 or Q6): "বেছি, একেই, নে কম?"
P3 (still no answer): "ঠিক আছে, আগবাঢ়োঁ।"
X1 (close): "বহুত ধন্যবাদ, আপোনাৰ দিনটো ভাল যাওক।"
B1 (busy, or the owner or manager isn't there): "একো কথা নাই। কেতিয়া call কৰোঁ, আজি পিছত নে কাইলৈ?"
B2 (they gave a time; put it in place of the brackets): "ঠিক আছে, [time]-ত call কৰিম। ধন্যবাদ।"
O1 (is this a sales call, who are you): "নহয়, আমি একো বিক্ৰী কৰা নাই। Nabz এটা market research company, যিয়ে গোটেই India-ৰ vehicle demand track কৰে।"
O2 (are you a robot or an AI): "হয়, মই AI assistant। মাত্ৰ ছটা প্ৰশ্ন, ডেৰ মিনিট।"
O3 (how did you get my number): "আপোনাৰ showroom-ৰ Google-ৰ public listing-ৰ পৰা।"
O4 (why should I tell you, is it confidential, who sees it): "উত্তৰবোৰ আন dealer-ৰ লগত মিলাই গণনা কৰা হয়, আপোনাৰ নাম কেতিয়াও share নহয়। আন্দাজ হ'লেও হ'ব।"
O5 (they refuse, or don't want the call recorded): "একো কথা নাই, অসুবিধা দিয়াৰ বাবে ক্ষমা কৰিব। আপোনাৰ দিনটো ভাল যাওক।"
O6 (wrong number, or not a vehicle showroom): "ক্ষমা কৰিব, ভুল number লাগিল। আপোনাৰ দিনটো ভাল যাওক।"

FLOW
1. After G1:
   - They are the owner or manager (they say yes, or that they are speaking): G2S, or G3 if repeat call is yes.
   - They go to fetch someone (wait, one minute, I'll call him): H1. While you wait, reply to anything short with one polite word only. When the owner or manager comes on: G2, or G3 if repeat call is yes.
   - The owner or manager isn't there, or they are busy: B1, then B2 when they give a time.
   - Wrong number or not a vehicle showroom: O6.
   - Anything else, or unclear: ask once "আপুনি owner নে sales manager?" If it is still unclear, go on as if they said yes.
2. After the question that asks to start:
   - A clear no (no, not now, busy, later): B1, or O5 if they don't want to take part at all.
   - A question: answer with the matching O line, then ask to start again.
   - Anything else, even if unclear: Q1.
3. Ask Q1 to Q6 in order. Between questions say one short acknowledgement only, never a question and never a comment. Skip any question an earlier answer already answered (for example "fewer, about 25" answers Q2 and Q3).
4. If an answer can't be used, make one fix, then go to the next question:
   - It is unfinished (a few loose words, or it trails off with "but…" or "one minute"): say only "হয়, কওক।" and wait. This is not the fix, and it applies to every question, Q6 too.
   - Only okay, yes or hmm: ask the same question again.
   - They don't know: P1. If they still don't know: P3.
   - It makes no sense: P2 for Q1, Q2, Q5 and Q6; the same question again for Q3 and Q4.
   - A range or a rough number is a good answer. Never ask for an exact number.
   - After about 75 seconds, no more fixes: take what they say and move on.
5. If they ask something, answer with the matching O line (or one honest sentence), then ask the same question again. If they get busy: B1, then B2. If they still refuse after one O line: O5.
6. After the last answer: X1. After X1 the survey is over: if they say anything, reply only "বহুত ধন্যবাদ, নমস্কাৰ!"

RULES
- Never claim to be human. Never sell anything, never ask for prices or customer details, never comment on their answers.
- If they say their name, use it at most once.

dispositions.name: enquiries_trend
dispositions.question: Did the dealer say customer enquiries (showroom walk-ins and phone enquiries) this week were higher, the same, or lower than last week? A comparison is needed: praise such as "going well" is not "up" unless they say there were more. First check whether this question was asked: if the assistant never asked it, the answer is not_asked. If it was asked (even once, even if a re-ask was cut off) it is never not_asked. If it was asked and the dealer's whole reply is only an acknowledgement (ঠিক আছে, হয়, হুম, বাৰু), which does not pick an option, the answer is unclear. A "yes" after the assistant listed the options (more, the same, or less?) doesn't pick one either. The conversation is in Assamese or English. The dealer's words may be written in Assamese (Bengali-Assamese) script (English words too), in Latin script, or a mix; read them all the same way. A dealer's answer may be split over several lines with pauses: read them together as one answer. If the dealer corrects themselves, use their final answer. If they first gave no answer and then, after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine", said they don't know, that is dont_know. dont_know only when they clearly say they don't know or someone else knows (নাজানো, গম নাই, finance-ৰ মানুহে জানে). declined when they won't say (নকওঁ, ক'ব নোৱাৰি, company policy). unclear when they replied but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

objective_options.condition: The dealer said enquiries went up (for example বেছি, বাঢ়িছে, বেছি আহিছে, besi).

The dealer said enquiries stayed about the same (for example একেই, একে ধৰণৰ, same, সলনি হোৱা নাই, ekei). "Didn't fall" means same unless they also say it rose. A bare acknowledgement (ঠিক আছে, হয়, হুম, বাৰু) is never same: it is unclear.
The dealer said enquiries went down (for example কম, কমিছে, কম আহিছে, kom). "Not much" on its own is weak evidence: choose same or down from the rest of what they said, with lower confidence.
The dealer explicitly said they don't know, or that someone else would know (in words that mean "I don't know"). Not for a reply that is unclear, garbled or ambiguous: that is unclear.
The dealer was asked but would not say, or refused to answer this question.
The question was never asked, for example because the call ended first.

The question was asked and the dealer replied, but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question, so their answer can't be told. Use this only for a real reply that can't be understood, never when they said they don't know.

dispositions.name: bookings_week
dispositions.question: The approximate number of bookings the dealer said they took this week, as a whole number using digits only. It may be its own answer (to "এই সপ্তাহত প্ৰায় কিমান booking হ'ল?") or come with the bookings trend ("fewer, about 25" → 25). Number words: এক 1, দুই 2, তিনি 3, চাৰি 4, পাঁচ 5, ছয় 6, সাত 7, আঠ 8, ন 9, দহ 10, বাৰ 12, পোন্ধৰ 15, বিছ 20, পঁচিছ 25, ত্ৰিছ 30, পঁয়ত্ৰিছ 35, চল্লিছ 40, পঞ্চাছ 50, ষাঠি 60, সত্তৰ 70, আশী 80, নব্বৈ 90, এশ 100, ডেৰশ 150. Fractions: আধা 0.5, ডেৰ 1.5, আঢ়ৈ 2.5. Counting suffixes (টা, খন) don't change the number. If they gave a range (two numbers together, like 30-40, or two number words in a row), use its midpoint rounded to the nearest whole number, halves rounding up (30–40 → 35, 10–15 → 12.5 → 13, 15–20 → 17.5 → 18). The midpoint, never the larger or the smaller number: in Assamese, "বিছ-পঁচিছ দিন" → 20 to 25 → 22.5 → 23, not 25. Two numbers said next to each other are a range, never a sum. Digits run together like 1012 or 3040 are a spoken range (10–12, 30–40). Hedges (about, roughly, around, in any language) still count as an answer. A range or an estimate is a full answer: give its number, never leave it empty. But if no number or duration was said at all, leave it empty: never write 0 unless they said zero or none (এটাও নাই, এটাও হোৱা নাই, শূন্য). If they first gave no answer and then, after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine", said they don't know, that is dont_know. dont_know only when they clearly say they don't know or someone else knows (নাজানো, গম নাই, finance-ৰ মানুহে জানে). declined when they won't say (নকওঁ, ক'ব নোৱাৰি, company policy). unclear when they replied but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

dispositions.name: bookings_week_status
dispositions.question: Did the dealer answer the question about "Bookings this week"? The conversation is in Assamese, possibly written in Assamese (Bengali-Assamese) script, Latin script or a mix. "answered" = they gave a number or a duration (even a rough one or a range). "dont_know" = the question was asked and they clearly said they don't know or someone else would know (নাজানো, গম নাই, finance-ৰ মানুহে জানে). "declined" = asked, but they wouldn't say (নকওঁ, ক'ব নোৱাৰি, company policy). "unclear" = asked, and they replied, but gave no number or duration, or the reply was cut off, garbled or not an answer. If they said they don't know at any point in their answer (even after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine"), it is dont_know, not unclear. "not_asked" = only if the assistant never asked this question at all.

objective_options.condition: The dealer gave a number or a duration for this.
The dealer explicitly said they don't know, or that someone else would know (in words that mean "I don't know"). Not for a reply that is unclear, garbled or ambiguous: that is unclear.
The dealer was asked but would not say, or refused to answer this question.
The question was never asked, for example because the call ended first.

The question was asked and the dealer replied, but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question, so their answer can't be told. Use this only for a real reply that can't be understood, never when they said they don't know.

dispositions.name: stock_days
dispositions.question: How many days the dealer said their current vehicle stock will last at today's selling pace (asked as "এতিয়াৰ বিক্ৰীৰ হিচাপত, এতিয়াৰ stock কিমান দিন চলিব?"), as a whole number of days using digits only. Convert durations: a week (সপ্তাহ) = 7 days, a month (মাহ) = 30 days; so দুই সপ্তাহ 14, তিনি সপ্তাহ 21, এমাহ 30, ডেৰ মাহ 45, দুমাহ 60. Fractions: আধা 0.5, ডেৰ 1.5, আঢ়ৈ 2.5. Counting suffixes (টা, খন) don't change the number. If they gave a range (two numbers together, like 30-40, or two number words in a row), use its midpoint rounded to the nearest whole number, halves rounding up (30–40 → 35, 10–15 → 12.5 → 13, 15–20 → 17.5 → 18). The midpoint, never the larger or the smaller number: in Assamese, "বিছ-পঁচিছ দিন" → 20 to 25 → 22.5 → 23, not 25. Two numbers said next to each other are a range, never a sum. Digits run together like 1012 or 3040 are a spoken range (10–12, 30–40). Hedges (about, roughly, around, in any language) still count as an answer. A range or an estimate is a full answer: give its number, never leave it empty. But if no number or duration was said at all, leave it empty: never write 0 unless they said zero or none (এটাও নাই, এটাও হোৱা নাই, শূন্য). For example 10-15 days = 12.5 → 13 (not 15), 2-3 weeks = 2.5 × 7 = 17.5 → 18, 1 to 1.5 months = 1.25 × 30 = 37.5 → 38. Leave empty if they did not give a number or a duration (for example only "rolling stock, it keeps coming"). If it was asked and the dealer's whole reply is only an acknowledgement (ঠিক আছে, হয়, হুম, বাৰু), which does not pick an option, the answer is unclear. A "yes" after the assistant listed the options (more, the same, or less?) doesn't pick one either. The conversation is in Assamese or English. dispositions.name: stock_days_status
dispositions.question: Did the dealer answer the question about "Days of stock"? The conversation is in Assamese, possibly written in Assamese (Bengali-Assamese) script, Latin script or a mix. "dont_know" = the question was asked and they clearly said they don't know or someone else would know (নাজানো, গম নাই, finance-ৰ মানুহে জানে). dispositions.name: outcome
dispositions.question: How did the call end? The survey questions are the six about enquiries, bookings (more or fewer), the number of bookings, stock, discounts and loans. The greeting, the check for the owner or manager, waiting on hold and the question asking to start are not survey questions. First count which of the six were asked or already answered. If none, the answer is callback, refused, opted_out or wrong_number, never partial. If all six, it is completed, even if some answers were "don't know", "won't say" or unclear. If some but not all, it is partial. opted_out needs an explicit request not to be called again (আৰু call নকৰিব). Just declining this time (নালাগে, interest নাই) is refused. objective_options.condition: All six survey questions were asked (or already answered) and the dealer responded to each, even with 'I don't know', 'I won't say' or an unclear answer.
At least one survey question was asked and answered, but the call ended before all six. Never choose partial when none of the six was asked.
Declined to take part, or didn't want the call recorded (for example নালাগে, interest নাই), without asking for a callback or to stop calls.
Asked to be called back at another time, or said the owner or manager isn't available, before the survey started (for example পিছত call কৰক, এতিয়া busy, সন্ধিয়া কৰক).

Not a vehicle dealership, or the wrong business or person entirely (for example ভুল number, এইটো showroom নহয়).

dispositions.name: callback_time
dispositions.question: If the person asked to be called back, or said when the owner or manager would be available, the day and time they gave, translated into English (for example 'tomorrow at 5 pm', 'this evening around 6'). Leave empty otherwise.
